notes.title: Game has been updated
notes.content:
Just some small tweaks based on feedback

[list]
[*] censored font for menu is a bit clearer to read (but still obstructed enough to give the look I was going for)
[*] Nurse section where you can buy lives now has additional text to further explain how to purchase lives
[*] bonus previews  videos 
[/list]

I have done vigorous teesting and full playthroughs to ensure there are no issues but if theres any suggestions you have or you run into something needing further adjustments let me know. I hope you are enjoying the game series.

Please leave a psoitive review and help spread the word about our games !

notes.title: Difficulty tweak to mini boss battles
notes.content:
I have made it a bit easier to face the mini bosses. Please let me know what you think of the games difficulty and if theres any changes you would suggest.

If you are enjoying the game please help spread the word and leave a positive review !
